name: Verify that the Create News form contains the particular fields.
description:
Verify that all fields in the Create News form are visible and have correct default values.

    Steps:
    1. Set window size and language.
    2. Verify title field and counter.
    3. Verify tags visibility and default selection.
    4. Verify image upload component.
    5. Verify source field visibility and default value.
    6. Verify content field, toolbar, counter, and default text.
    7. Verify author field visibility and value.
    8. Verify post date field visibility.
    9. Verify action buttons (Cancel, Preview, Publish) visibility.
    10. Verify that all fields except author match expected language-specific data.
